label_policy.note: The managed-beta SLO layer is cell/operation aggregate telemetry. Customer identifiers and unbounded resource names belong only in access-controlled audit/support systems, never Prometheus labels.

slos.name: Public API availability
slos.objective: At least 99.5% successful eligible external probes per approved cell over a rolling 28-day window.

source_series.name: fiducia_external_probe_total
source_series.producer: Independent black-box probes from at least two failure-independent locations
source_series.eligibility: Only configured approved-capability probes enter this series; invalid-customer-input probes use a separate diagnostic series.

slos.review_cadence: Daily and in the weekly design-partner review

slos.name: Eligible data-plane operation success
slos.objective: At least 99.9% successful eligible data-plane operations per approved cell over a rolling 28-day window.

source_series.name: fiducia_data_plane_requests_total
source_series.producer: Regional load balancer canonical request instrumentation after auth and route classification
source_series.eligibility: Outcomes use bounded classes: success, expected_conflict, customer_rejected, server_error, timeout, ambiguous. The SLI denominator excludes customer_rejected and includes server_error, timeout, and ambiguous.

slos.name: Linearizable read latency
slos.objective: Linearizable reads complete with p95 at or below 500 ms and p99 at or below 2 seconds.

source_series.name: fiducia_data_plane_request_duration_seconds
source_series.producer: Regional load balancer latency measured from accepted request to completed response
source_series.eligibility: operation_class is one of linearizable_read, status_read, secret_read, or watch_reconcile; the read SLI selects linearizable_read and successful outcomes.

slos.name: Committed write latency
slos.objective: Committed mutations complete with p95 at or below 1.5 seconds and p99 at or below 4 seconds.

source_series.name: fiducia_data_plane_request_duration_seconds
source_series.producer: Regional load balancer plus a canonical committed-response classification from the data plane
source_series.eligibility: The SLI selects operation_class=committed_write and outcome=success; customer rejections and expected conflicts are not latency successes.

slos.name: Eligible lock and lease renewal success
slos.objective: At least 99.9% of eligible renewals submitted with at least one third of TTL remaining commit successfully.

source_series.name: fiducia_renewal_attempts_total
source_series.producer: Data-plane renewal handler after classifying TTL safety margin and current-holder/token validity
source_series.eligibility: operation_class is lock_renew or lease_renew; eligible attempts have a valid current holder/token and at least one third of TTL remaining.

slos.review_cadence: Continuous paging plus weekly partner review

slos.name: One-site and current-leader recovery
slos.objective: Controlled and real one-site/current-leader loss events recover at p95 within 15 seconds, with no observed recovery above 30 seconds and no safety violation.

source_series.name: fiducia_failover_recovery_seconds
source_series.producer: Failure-test harness and incident controller from fault-start timestamp to sustained successful committed probe
source_series.eligibility: fault_class is bounded to leader_loss, follower_loss, site_power_loss, or site_network_loss; result is recovered or failed.

source_series.name: fiducia_failover_safety_violations_total
source_series.eligibility: result is a bounded violation class such as stale_fencing, committed_state_loss, dual_commit, or cross_tenant.

slos.review_cadence: Every drill, incident, and release candidate

slos.name: Credential rotation and revocation propagation
slos.objective: A rotated or revoked credential is rejected on every supported ingress at p99 within 60 seconds.

source_series.name: fiducia_credential_revocation_seconds
source_series.producer: Credential lifecycle conformance probe measuring authoritative-version timestamp to last accepted old-credential request
source_series.eligibility: credential_kind is api_key, fiducia_jwt, human_session, internal_service, peer, or device; no credential identifiers appear in labels.

source_series.name: fiducia_credential_revocation_bound_violations_total
source_series.eligibility: Increment once per old credential accepted after its declared bound.

slos.review_cadence: Every release, credential drill, and security incident

slos.name: Encrypted secret read latency
slos.objective: Approved encrypted secret/KV reads complete with p95 at or below 1 second and p99 at or below 3 seconds.

source_series.name: fiducia_data_plane_request_duration_seconds
source_series.producer: Customer and ESO synthetic probes measured at the supported ingress
source_series.eligibility: The SLI selects operation_class=secret_read and outcome=success. Secret path/value, organization, and credential identifiers are forbidden labels.

slos.name: Watch reconnect and reconciliation
slos.objective: After a planned LB/node interruption, p95 time from disconnect to reconnected and linearizably reconciled current state is at or below 15 seconds.

source_series.name: fiducia_watch_recovery_seconds
source_series.producer: SDK conformance and external synthetic watcher harness
source_series.eligibility: A successful sample requires stream reconnect plus a linearizable reconciliation read; merely reopening TCP/SSE is not success.

slos.review_cadence: Per release candidate and SDK release

slos.name: Incident acknowledgement
slos.objective: Sev-0 incidents are acknowledged within 15 minutes and Sev-1 incidents within 60 minutes while beta workloads are live.

source_series.name: fiducia_incident_timeline
source_series.producer: Paging/incident system export with declared_at, acknowledged_at, resolved_at, incident_id, and severity fields
source_series.eligibility: All Sev-0 and Sev-1 incidents during an approved live-workload window are included; drills are marked separately and do not replace real incident measurements.

objective_queries.name: incident_acknowledgement_bounds_28d
objective_queries.expression: SELECT severity, count(*) AS incidents, max(extract(epoch FROM (acknowledged_at - declared_at))) AS max_ack_seconds FROM fiducia_incident_timeline WHERE declared_at >= now() - interval '28 days' AND severity IN ('Sev-0','Sev-1') GROUP BY severity
objective_queries.pass_condition: Sev-0 max_ack_seconds <= 900 and Sev-1 max_ack_seconds <= 3600; zero incidents is reported as no-observation, not an invented 100% result

alert_queries.name: FiduciaSev0Unacknowledged
alert_queries.expression: Incident-system timer: declared Sev-0 has no acknowledgement after 15 minutes

alert_queries.name: FiduciaSev1Unacknowledged
alert_queries.expression: Incident-system timer: declared Sev-1 has no acknowledgement after 60 minutes

slos.review_cadence: Every incident and weekly while beta workloads are live
